idea: A boy flies a red kite on a windy cliff above the sea. The string snaps and the kite drifts away over the water. His grandfather finds it caught on the rocks of the beach below and brings it back to him.

panels.prompt: Full-color cinematic film still, medium shot from slightly low angle at cliff’s edge during golden hour. Leo is mid-stride, arms flung back, laughing as he releases his red kite into the gusts of wind. Behind him, Grandpa Finn stands motionless near the edge, watching intently but holding nothing. Wind whips through their clothes and sends loose strands flying. In frame-left foreground, the kite soars high overhead, its tail whipping like a flag. Leo is 10-year-old boy, fair skin, short brown hair, wearing a faded blue t-shirt and khaki shorts. His eyes are wide with excitement as he runs barefoot on the cliff edge.Grandpa. Finn is 65-year-old man, weathered face, gray stubble, wearing a navy wool jacket over a plaid shirt, dark trousers, and sturdy hiking boots. He carries a worn leather satchel.Red. Kite is a large red diamond-shaped kite with black trim — not animated or sentient in this scene.Cliff. Edge is the rocky outcrop above sea level; wind-swept grasses fluttering wildly.Beach.
panels.intent: Establish Leo's joyous freedom as the kite begins to rise—this moment feels carefree before disaster strikes.

panels.prompt: Medium close-up tracking shot following Leo’s panicked expression as he turns sharply toward the horizon after hearing a sudden snap. His hands clutch the string tightly now, knuckles white. Frame-right shows Grandpa Finn stepping forward slowly, hand raised—not yet moving—but already aware something has gone wrong. Background blur indicates strong winds. Leo is 10-year-old boy, fair skin, short brown hair, wearing a faded blue t-shirt and khaki shorts. His eyes are wide with excitement as he runs barefoot on the cliff edge.Grandpa. Finn is 65-year-old man, weathered face, gray stubble, wearing a navy wool jacket over a plaid shirt, dark trousers, and sturdy hiking boots. He carries a worn leather satchel.Red.
panels.intent: Show Leo’s shift from exhilaration to alarm—the camera moves subtly with his panic, emphasizing that danger is imminent.

panels.prompt: Wide establishing shot looking down from cliff top onto turbulent ocean below. Red kite hangs suspended just above wave crest, caught between two massive swells. Its line dangles limp across the air. Sea spray glints off wet rock formations beneath it. No one is visible except for faint silhouettes of figures standing far away along shoreline. Kite is a large red diamond-shaped kite with black trim — not animated or sentient in this scene.Cliff. Sea is turquoise water under stormy sky, waves crashing against shore.
panels.intent: Reveal scale of peril—a single object lost amid chaos—and imply how quickly things can turn dangerous without intervention.

panels.prompt: Low-angle ground-level shot focused entirely on Grandpa Finn crouched beside broken coral reef stones by beachfront. He grips rope ends firmly while pulling hard upward—he doesn’t look up at anything else. Water drips around his ankles. Sand clings to his shoes. Finn is 65-year-old man, weathered face, gray stubble, wearing a navy wool jacket over a plaid shirt, dark trousers, and sturdy hiking boots. He carries a worn leather satchel.Red.
panels.intent: Introduce tension via physical effort—his body language conveys urgency and determination even though no sound exists here.

panels.prompt: Tight close-up on Leo’s trembling fingers gripping the end of snapped string dangling uselessly from his palm. Tears well behind his eyes despite laughter earlier. He stares blankly ahead, mouth open silently screaming inwardly. Frame-center focuses only on his face and shaking hands. Leo is 10-year-old boy, fair skin, short brown hair, wearing a faded blue t-shirt and khaki shorts. His eyes are wide with excitement as he runs barefoot on the cliff edge.Grandpa.
panels.intent: Capture emotional climax—the loss hits harder than any crash because there was never an escape plan.

panels.prompt: Slow-motion reverse-tracking pan from right-to-left ending with full-frame view showing both men together again—at sunset, kneeling side-by-side on damp sand next to recovered kite lying flat on earth. Grandpa holds it gently while Leo reaches out tentatively, touching its fabric. Both stare quietly at each other, silence heavy. Leo is 10-year-old boy, fair skin, short brown hair, wearing a faded blue t-shirt and khaki shorts. His eyes are wide with excitement as he runs barefoot on the cliff edge.Grandpa. Kite is a large red diamond-shaped kite with black trim — not animated or sentient in this scene.Cliff.
panels.intent: End with resolution—not triumph, but quiet understanding—as they share responsibility for what happened and begin rebuilding trust anew.
